title: ECG for laboratory values:A comprehensive physiological and technical analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.28507v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Laboratory measurements are essential for clinical decision making but typically require invasive blood sampling. Recent research suggests that ECG recordings may contain information beyond cardiac rhythm and provide information related to laboratory values. This thesis investigates NT-proBNP prediction from ECG recordings and patient metadata using a multimodal deep learning framework, while considering the physiological plausibility of ECG-based prediction. It also compares a 1-lead configuration using lead II with the corresponding 12-lead configuration. Additional experiments on glucose, hemoglobin, and potassium are presented in the appendix.   Regression, binary classification, and three-class classification experiments were conducted using MIMIC-IV, with the three-class task based on clinically established thresholds. translated_title: 心电图用于实验室检测值：一项全面的生理学与技术分析
translated_abstract: 实验室检测对临床决策至关重要，但通常需要进行有创的血液采样。近年来的研究表明，心电图记录可能包含超越心律本身的信息，并能提供与实验室检测值相关的信息。本论文使用多模态深度学习框架，从心电图记录和患者元数据中预测NT-proBNP，同时考虑了基于心电图的预测在生理学上的合理性。论文还比较了使用II导联的单导联配置与相应的12导联配置。附录中还展示了关于血糖、血红蛋白和钾离子的补充实验。研究基于MIMIC-IV数据集进行了回归、二分类和三分类实验，其中三分类任务基于临床确立的阈值。12导联配置始终取得了更好的性能。回归任务达到了……的平均绝对误差（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 本论文提出了一种多模态深度学习框架，利用心电图记录和患者元数据预测NT-proBNP等实验室检测值，验证了心电图预测的生理学合理性，并发现12导联配置的性能始终优于单导联配置。
en_tdlr: This thesis proposes a multimodal deep learning framework to predict laboratory values such as NT-proBNP from ECG recordings and patient metadata, confirming the physiological plausibility of ECG-based prediction and showing that the 12-lead configuration consistently outperforms the single-lead setup.
